title: On the Binary Rank of Matrices with Constant Real Rank
summary: We study the problem of determining upper bounds on the maximal binary rank, $b_d$, of a $0,1$ matrix with real rank $d$, for small constant $d$. We prove a general upper bound of $b_d \leq \left\lfloor \sqrt{d2^d + 2d}\right\rfloor -1$. We also develop a general dimension reduction technique of bounding $b_d$ using known upper bounds on $b_{d-1}$ and $b_{d-2}$, as well as prove interesting general structural results on extremal matrices with binary rank $b_d$.
